requirements.remediation: Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.

requirements.rule: SENIORITY: frozen at 31/12/2005. Art. 29 clause 1 of the CCNL 2024 lists 'salario di anzianità maturato al 31/12/2005' as a retributive element. Art. 32 governs this frozen amount. No new scatti di anzianità accrue after 2005. The current progression mechanism is POC (Progressione Orizzontale di Carriera), calculated as 100% of the 3-year average of PAP productivity awards (Art. 38, in force from 31/08/2024), which is merit-conditioned and excluded from Layer 1. Maximum_count set to 0; amount_by_level set to 0.00 EUR for all levels. Cadence_months set to 1 (minimum legal value; maximum_count=0 so no scatti ever apply; historical quinquennial cadence noted here only). Supply the worker's actual frozen monthly balance as IndividualElement(code='frozen_seniority', monthly=<preserved monthly balance>, absorbable=False, as_of=None, extra_months=True, tfr_relevant=True). Art. 32 explicitly makes it non-revaluable and non-absorbable; Art. 29 includes it in global pay and Art. 33 includes December pay in the thirteenth. Art. 90 includes non-occasional pay in the TFR base. The PDF supplies no universal historical amount.
requirements.remediation: Supply the worker's actual preserved monthly balance as an individual element; without that fact no historical amount can be inferred.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
